rule: Do not connect to or write to any Sanity dataset in Phase 3.
gates_before_generating_import_ndjson: Compare this mapping against the actual Phase 1 Studio schema field names and validation rules.
Resolve high-priority review queue items or explicitly mark records draft-only.
Confirm KULT360 Sanity project/dataset is new and not photographer CMS.
Confirm media rights and credit fields for assets selected for publication.
Source full Journal bodies for any article intended to publish.
Review EN/SQ translation status; do not auto-invent translations.
Approve redirect targets and canonical slugs.
draft_policy: Incomplete but useful metadata may become Sanity drafts only after schema review. Never publish incomplete or unverified records automatically.
